In-Depth Engineering Corporation seeks software engineers to support its growing research programs. The role designs, develops, integrates, and tests software solutions for the Aegis Display Subsystem, using C++, Java, Linux, and Kubernetes in an agile environment, while also supporting documentation, peer reviews, customer activities, and software investigations.
